scope: Retrospective diagnostic of all 18,620 fully sealed ordinary Validation scores. Independent of the 501-record two-pool prototype. No new target predictions or selection.
question: Even allowing an oracle to choose per-expression nonnegative weights on the three frozen score components, can any qualifying original subject slot strictly outrank every failing slot?
weights: Shared across slots within a description, all weights nonnegative and sum to one. This includes all possible positive relative scales and the option to ignore a component. Weights can differ by input and IoU threshold only for the retrospective upper bound. Per-candidate gates and new information are outside this class.
accounting: First isolate failures with at least one passing slot. Count exact dominance of every passing slot by some failing slot, feasible strict separation by any three-component weighting, and remaining nonseparable undominated cases. Report best attainable normalized score margin near zero and audit the rank boundary at 1e-9.
